# syntax

Types from the Go package `syntax` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## syntax.Flags

Flags control the behavior of the parser and record information about regexp context.

Has everything <code>Number</code> has.
